artists.biography: A supergroup of sought after songwriters and musicians, former members of the legendary band Jellyfish. The musical journeys of Eric Dover, Roger Joseph Manning Jr. and Tim Smith have synchronized for the first time since 1994. Just like any great relationship, they simply picked up where they left off. Roger Joseph Manning Jr. (Beck, Air, Cheap Trick and Imperial Drag) Eric Dover (Imperial Drag, Slash's Snakepit, Alice Cooper, Sextus) Tim Smith (Noel Gallagher's High Flying Birds, The Finn Brothers, Sheryl Crow, Umajets) Website: https://thelickerishquartet.com/ Twitter: @thelickerish Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Threesome Vol. 3 by The Lickerish Quartet, released in 2022 on Lojinx, is the final installment in a trilogy of EPs that together form the group’s debut album. The band, featuring ex-Jellyfish members Roger Joseph Manning Jr., Tim Smith, and Eric Dover, delivers a polished blend of melodic rock and power pop, drawing clear influences from classic acts like Supertramp, ELO, and Jellyfish while refining their own distinct sound. The EP is noted for its lush harmonies, intricate arrangements, and strong songwriting, with the single "Fortunately" standing out as a highlight that showcases the group’s mastery of pop rock craftsmanship.

Musically, Threesome Vol. 3 completes a project that began with Threesome Vol. 1 in 2020, which was widely praised as a masterpiece by critics and fans. The trilogy’s release in installments allowed the band to build anticipation and refine their approach across each volume. The final EP received strong critical acclaim, with reviewers highlighting its consistency, melodic richness, and the seamless integration of the members’ diverse musical backgrounds. The album’s success solidified The Lickerish Quartet’s reputation as a leading force in modern melodic rock, earning high ratings and positive reviews upon its release.
